sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Mini Steps are simple yet challenging. Players control a small step character that must navigate through a series of obstacles, collecting coins and power-ups while avoiding deadly traps. The game's controls are easy to learn, with players using their chosen input method (mouse, keyboard, or touch) to move the step character left or right. The step character can jump over obstacles or fall into deadly traps, making timing and spatial awareness crucial to progress.

As players progress through the levels, the game introduces new obstacles, power-ups, and collectibles that add variety and challenge to the gameplay. Players can collect coins, which can be used to unlock new levels or purchase power-ups to aid in their progress. Power-ups, such as temporary invincibility or speed boosts, can be used strategically to overcome the most challenging levels.

One of the key features of Mini Steps is its 'steps' system, which allows players to collect and combine steps to unlock new abilities and enhance their progress. This system adds a new layer of depth to the gameplay, as players must carefully plan and manage their steps to maximize their progress.

To master the game's core mechanics, players should focus on developing their timing and spatial awareness. Practice makes perfect, so take your time and get comfortable with the game's controls before attempting the more challenging levels.
